#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p run
rm -f run/qmp.sock run/qemu.pid run/qemu.log
nohup qemu-system-i386   -m 32   -cpu 486   -drive file=isos/win311.img,format=raw,if=ide,snapshot=on   -vnc 127.0.0.1:1   -qmp unix:run/qmp.sock,server,nowait -S   -serial none   -parallel none   -display none   -net none   -rtc base=localtime   >run/qemu.log 2>&1 &
 echo $! > run/qemu.pid

qmp_exists True
qmp_connect_fail
LISTEN 0      1          127.0.0.1:5901      0.0.0.0:*    users:(("qemu-system-i38",pid=1292,fd=12))
